entry.title: What is Devops
entry.summary:
What is Devops
The term "DevOps" itself is a combination of Development and Operations. It's not just a single life cycle but a culture, a set of practices, and a philosophy that aims to unify software development (Dev) and software operations (Ops). Think of it this way: traditionally, the Dev team would build a product and then "throw it over the wall" to the Ops team to deploy and maintain. This created a lot of friction, delays, and blame. DevOps seeks to break down this "wall" by fostering collaboration and communication between these two teams. So, while your understanding of DevOps involving the public release of software is a key component, it's also about a cultural shift within an organization. It's about collaboration, automation, and continuous improvement.
